g.title: j2091945361
g.text: do you know where my On-lyne CD ended up?

g.title: j1192354908
g.text: I'm sure there's another in that CD store you hang out in.

g.title: j4114013053
g.text: if you need study material for that super ez hit pop song ur working on, all u need to do is ask

g.title: j2534450654
g.text: I'm getting the sense I hit a nerve with that whole four chord song thing.

g.title: j4001427422
g.text: Nah, I know what four chords on loop sound like already.

g.title: j1700844057
g.text: I figure u might have borrowed it <3 being a fan and all

g.title: j3357731316
g.text: Nope. Can you track it down with your metal powers?

g.title: j440371180
g.text: You seem upset. Is it something I said?

g.title: j465505677
g.text: do rats like shiny things? maybe Lettie's rat took it.

g.title: j3685863605
g.text: (Amir tells me there are no CDs in the future so)

g.title: j1099314096
g.text: Maybe the rat's an On-lyne fan too

g.title: j3646139699
g.text: Haha I actually think they do. Not sure they could carry a CD in their little paws though.

g.title: j776351929
g.text: I didn't love being called boring.

g.title: j908465644
g.text: I actually think it's cool how you see past the surface of pop music.

g.title: j206322510
g.text: Look, we aren't all going to like the same things.

g.title: j3159420591
g.text: I don't think Zeke would approve of stealing. (No, I didn't take it. Lol.)

g.title: j3751020008
g.text: There are no CD players either, so even if I had it, I wouldn't be able to do much with it.

g.title: j2155054980
g.text: Oh... Well, metal makes a big comeback in the future

g.title: j1120728246
g.text: That's too bad. I'm out of ideas.

g.title: j1539331091
g.text: Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.

g.title: j1521590647
g.text: Jokes aside, I really hope you find it.

g.title: j300530424
g.text: Well, good luck with your search.

g.title: j4002448054
g.text: then I will dominate the future!

g.title: j3830064706
g.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.

g.title: j3782922074
g.text: You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.

g.title: j2174895471
g.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.

g.title: j2552751752
g.text: It seems the jury's convinced by your defense

g.title: j878098687
g.text: What is it that upset you? I'm not judging. I really want to know.

g.title: j1534128303
g.text: No worries. Hope you find your CD.

g.title: j3040347896
g.text: and grants you a fresh start

g.title: j2711941602
g.text: hope u have a good day ^_^

g.title: j1238163645
g.text: well, nobody comes after punk songs for being three power chords, u know?

g.title: j377657138
g.text: Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.

g.title: j1554060460
g.text: like sure, thrash out three chords and shout about making out with 10 blondes in a night. that's sooo cool. ur sooo real

g.title: j2609146614
g.text: but sing about being devoted to a girl? true luv? bringing people together at a party? now ur a sellout

g.title: j1765706338
g.text: uuh no offense to the 10 blondes. they can come to the party.

g.title: j4118167921
g.text: No, I get it. It's the double standard that bothers you.

g.title: j1089915828
g.text: I think you might be overthinking this.

g.title: j1044178475
g.text: yes! like I enjoy rock as much as the next girl, but let's not pretend it's less produced than pop

g.title: j3524047531
g.text: I just mean you should like whatever you like. Screw what everyone else thinks.

g.title: j688069700
g.text: I'm not trying to offend you or anything.

g.title: j1678059440
g.text: Neither is better. They're just different flavors.

g.title: j3036519640
g.text: You've thought a lot about this.

g.title: j1520185988
g.text: True, and you deserve people in your corner who understand your point of view either way.

g.title: j756870434
g.text: thx for the advice, I guess

g.title: j1423856813
g.text: i'm gonna get back to finding my CD. have a good one.

g.title: j1469249845
g.text: i'm gonna go. not trying to offend u or anything.

g.title: j1288161489
g.text: I'm gonna get back to finding my CD. thx for the chat

g.title: j3652372862
g.text: I'll do my best to be one of those people.
